machine: datathon3 only; never datathon2 live GPU
notes: Parent stages this owned directory on datathon3 before executing argv. Stage is separate from the read-only combined base.
Weights must already exist at --model. No model download, fallback model, package install or service restart.

Launcher selects an existing Transformers>=5 + Accelerate ML Python and prints the choice; SAFE_PROBE_PYTHON may name an explicit existing interpreter. Actual interpreter/packages are saved in metadata.
Parent holds shared GPU flock and total timeout; do not run CUDA in worker sandbox or on datathon2's live GPU.
